unofficial_api_notice: This adapter uses an unofficial OBI/heyOBI API that may change at any time.
email_help: Email address used to sign in to your OBI/heyOBI account.
password_help: Stored in the protected adapter configuration and never written to logs.
poll_interval_help: OBI normally updates historical data about every five minutes.
live_enabled_help: Increases sensor activity. Some devices provide RSSI and battery but no power value.
debug_api_help: May expose device identifiers. Never publish logs without anonymising them.
